definitions.explanation: A regular pattern of beats or sounds in music.
A regular pattern or flow in life or activities.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}はリズムがいい。
examples.english: This song has a good rhythm.

examples.japanese: リズムに{合|あ}わせて{踊|おど}る。
{生活|せいかつ}のリズムを{整|ととの}える。
examples.english: Establish a regular rhythm in your life.

notes:
リズム refers to both musical rhythm and the pace/pattern of activities or life.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- リズムに{乗|の}る: to get into the rhythm
- リズムを{取|と}る: to keep rhythm
- リズムを{刻|きざ}む: to mark/beat out rhythm
- リズム{感|かん}: sense of rhythm

COMPOUNDS:
- {生活|せいかつ}リズム: daily rhythm/routine
- {仕事|しごと}のリズム: work pace
- {体内|たいない}リズム: biological rhythm

USAGE:
In the "pace of life" sense, リズムを{整|ととの}える (to regulate one's rhythm) is commonly used when talking about establishing healthy routines.

Note: From English "rhythm."
